_about: Parity pass 2 (the User 2026-10-10): the reference install's GPU mode switch and its studio, copied whole into krew. crew/scripts/krew-mode is the reference mode switch (normal | render <recipe> | beast | off | heavy-render | heavy-exit | ada-caps | hold-sweep | release-card), with its seams cut: the tree, the flag, the hold file and the per-mode dispatch caps are krew.yaml `gpu:` keys (the reference values as defaults), the engine and voice units and ports are $KREW_HOME/services.json rows (krew-engine@ops / @crew without a row), the Wall is reached through CRISSA_PLAYER, every kill switch is the reference one renamed KREW_*. heavy-render.py, render-cycle.py, render-still.py and turbo-krew.py are its siblings; crew/lib/render_studio.py, render_wip.py, render_orders.py and crissa_gateway.py are the studio and its helpers, which the Crissa feed's /v1/render-studio* routes import when krew is installed (the feed finds crew/lib through $CRISSA_HOME/krew-lib.path, written by krew-install).

gpu-mode.about: The GPU mode switch and the Render studio (crew/scripts/krew-mode and its siblings, the studio libs). Installed with crew/ to $KREW_HOME/crew; krew-crew-install links $KREW_HOME/bin/krew-mode to it, the path every krew caller defaults to. Comfy is the user's own (KREW_COMFY_ROOT, default ~/ComfyUI). glass_mode and zos_brave are the Wall's kiosk modules (the Crissa pack's): without them the studio's show-on-the-glass step answers 'front failed' and nothing else changes.

absent_ok_imports.glass_mode: the Wall's kiosk glass (Crissa): the studio's front-tab step and the status line's kiosk mark degrade
absent_ok_imports.zos_brave: the Wall's background browser (Crissa): a finished render is not tabbed in the background
